connector.name: PikaSim
connector.registryDescription: Anonymous eSIMs, phone numbers, and SMS codes in 190+ countries. Crypto-paid; agents self-onboard.
connector.summary: Hosted at pikasim.com over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.pikasim, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
